notes: Account snapshot: Axion is a mid-to-large legal-tech platform providing contract search + compliance monitoring for large enterprise customers.
Current architecture: Elasticsearch + BM25 first stage, then a Tensor-based reranker hosted internally (GPU pool). Embeddings used for semantic recall in a separate pipeline (approx 200M vectors).
Primary ask: migrate embeddings + reranker to a managed inference stack that reduces cost and simplifies ops while preserving or improving quality.
Scale targets: indexing window ~500M vectors initially; roadmap to 1.2B within 12-18 months. They ingest nightly batches and require daily full-reindex possibility.
Latency SLA: P95 end-to-end query latency <= 200ms for interactive UI; acceptable background batch for analytics can be higher.
Cost target: target average compute cost per query <= $0.01 at 100k QPS-month equivalency. Want clear unit economics from Redwood Optimize recommendations.
Quality guardrails: cannot tolerate >1% delta in commercial metric (MRR-driving relevance). Product says "no visible regressions to customers" — will block any rollout otherwise.
Evals plan: set of curated prompt sets + holdout labeled judgments across 50k golden queries. Evaluate embeddings (cosine/topK) and learned reranker models (MRR, NDCG, pairwise accuracy).
Migration approach discussed: staged evals -> offline shadow evaluation -> A/B 5% traffic -> canary 25% -> ramp with rollback hooks. Need automatic fallback to older reranker variant on regressions.

Key technical concerns raised on call: indexing time for 500M vectors (ingest throughput), vector compression/quantization impact on reranker input, model latency variability (cold cache KV), and multi-region routing for EU customers.
Security/compliance notes: requirement for VPC deployment or on-prem for certain customers; must support SSO/SAML, KMS-backed keys, audit logs retention 7 years for some contracts.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-21): "If moving to a new embedder or reranker we need hard numbers — show us lifts on our evals and an escape hatch that guarantees no customer impact."

Recent POC (week 2): Redwood embeddings (opt-small) matched recall on 80% of golden queries but showed 0.8% MRR dip in a few high-value segments; reranker A improved NDCG but added 30ms median latency.
Sales angle: propose Dedicated cluster in NA + Private control plane for EU-residency customers; use Redwood Optimize to propose quantization+batching profile to hit cost targets.
Operational asks: must have canary automation (A/B by user cohort), per-query cost telemetry, and evals integration that triggers rollback if MRR drop >0.5% over 24h window.
Decision timeline: legal & security sign-off expected by mid-April, procurement cycle targeting May close if POC meets quality/latency/cost gates.

Internal redwood follow-ups: provide Evals baseline workbook, propose concrete A/B traffic split template, size Dedicated gpu pool for 500M vector indexing, and provide an objective cost projection for 1B vector read QPS.
Next scheduled items: 1) workshop with SE (Elena) on eval metric design 2026-03-14; 2) architecture review with security 2026-03-21; 3) kickoff POC week of 2026-04-04.
Sales notes: upsell path after successful migration — Dedicated + Optimize + extended observability for legal customers.
